visible_description: 装订书册剩下的一截线，正好留住最舍不得合上的那一页。
synopsis: 装订练习快结束时，学员发现自己留的线尾比别人长得多。她拿起剪刀又停住，把长线顺着书脊理下来，在末端结上一颗小木珠。朋友打开书，翻了几页，把那颗木珠轻轻夹在想停留的位置。后来两人交换看册子，木珠总在某一页外面晃着，像替翻书的人守着一个安静的座位。
story_text:
小册子装订完，姑娘发现自己的线尾比别人的长出一大截。那根黄线从书脊垂下来，绕过桌角，仿佛还没有决定工作什么时候结束。

她本来准备剪短，手指碰到桌上一颗木珠，忽然有了别的想法。她把珠子穿在线尾，打好结，再顺着书页把长线理直。

朋友拿起册子，翻到一张叶子的画，便把细线夹在那里，让木珠从封面下垂出来。合上以后，再打开，那片叶子仍在等她。

两个人交换着看小册子，一人刚记住树叶，另一人又想停在一块淡绿色的画迹上。小木珠一会儿垂在桌边，一会儿晃在膝前，始终不用谁来提醒它。
art_direction: Fine colored pencil and restrained gouache on textured parchment-colored paper
character_design: An adult bookbinding learner has a straight black bob tucked behind one ear, a moss cardigan, cream shirt and charcoal trousers. Her adult friend has copper curls, round spectacles, a dusty rose shirt and tan trousers. They bind small unlettered cream-paper books with plain plum cloth covers and ochre stitching. One long ochre thread end receives a single smooth pale wooden bead. All pages contain only simple original leaf sketches and abstract color patches, never words.

panels.caption: 她的线尾，比书还长了一截。
panels.scene: At a tidy bookbinding table, the learner holds a small plum-covered handmade book open near its spine. A conspicuously long ochre thread trails from the upper binding down across the cream pages and onto the table. Her friend holds a second similar book with a short neat thread end for comparison. Smooth paper sheets, a spool of thread and a small wooden bead sit nearby. Keep all pages blank except for a few simple leaf sketches. Wordless illustration; no letters, signs, logos, captions, speech balloons or interface text.

panels.caption: 剪短之前，她忽然换了主意。
panels.scene: In a close view of her hands, the learner threads the pale wooden bead onto the long ochre tail while the plum book lies open flat on the table. The bead hangs just beyond the bottom edge of the cover, and the long thread runs neatly from the top of the spine through the page center. Her friend watches with interest, chin resting lightly on one hand. No cutting action is shown; focus entirely on tying the little finishing knot. Wordless illustration; no letters, signs, logos, captions, speech balloons or interface text.

panels.caption: 这根线，开始替人记住一页。
panels.scene: The friend holds the finished plum book at a comfortable reading angle, opened to a simple green leaf drawing. With one finger, she lays the ochre thread down the inner page and lets the wooden bead dangle below the book. The learner watches the useful placement with a small smile. A second handmade book lies closed nearby, and the paper textures and hand-stitched spine remain visible in the softly lit studio. Wordless illustration; no letters, signs, logos, captions, speech balloons or interface text.

panels.caption: 合上以后，那一页仍有位置。
panels.scene: The two friends exchange their handmade books across the table. The plum book in the curly-haired friend hands is gently closed around the ochre thread, with its single wooden bead hanging below the cover like a small reserved marker. The learner receives the other cream-paper book and begins to open it. A plain cup and unused thread spool remain on the table, emphasizing a quiet finished craft rather than a dramatic reveal. Wordless illustration; no letters, signs, logos, captions, speech balloons or interface text.
